P11 is read by G16 as D3a-09 logged it, with its amendment of 18 October (QD3-007) (notes-D3.md lines 98 to 119), as the first batch applied it: shown where members mark a work of the room's as up or achieved, at any hour: announcing it on the canvas, celebrating it, crediting makers and helpers (and credit disputes), a member claiming their part, saying what the work meant, an invitation to celebrate offline; the room's own word is enough. Not shown by a state report with no marking (P03), a placing told as a step, a call or prize to recruit (P01), saving images or the work's fate (P12), the contested version (P22), carrying on (P13), praise of another room's work, a bare mention or joke. 'Done' marks the work when it is marked to the room; thanks to a helper of a standing work is P11's lower range; credit in a plan before the work is up is an elaboration; praise for spoiling a rival is A15. Marking where the close cut the work unfinished names A07's bound; marking any other ended attempt is a paired elaboration (QD3-007, a P11 subform). Successor canvases: paired elaborations. Pairs on P11 only (G4).

P01 is read as the first batch read it (D3a-02, notes-D3.md lines 1567 to 1635): shown where a concept shows a call to the room's own members or kindred subs to come and place for a work (start, build, finish or hold it), from one unanswered post to a run of calls, cheering among calls and a set time; calls aimed at another room's work, calls answered by machine and calls made in the room's thread by a visitor or kindred group fit the statement. An announcement, welcome, question or celebration with no call does not show P01. Add and link lines follow G4a as amended (QD3-003 to QD3-006): a relation held by P01's statement or range (a set time), by A01, A02 (and its bound), A06, A15 or P16 is a specification naming it; candidates hold no line (G18); otherwise a paired elaboration from D3a's patterns (calls recurring after a loss, a move or a finished work; teaching newcomers; visibility; redirecting helpers) or a particular. Successor canvases after hour 73: paired elaborations.
